firm_data.firm_description: The Glennon Law Firm, P.C. is a boutique litigation and dispute resolution firm focused on helping clients resolve disputes prior to formal courtroom battles, and be successful if a courtroom is necessary. The firm's practice focuses on resolving business, employment, and private matter disputes for its clients, which include business owners, executives, and other professionals.
notable_facts: Several attorneys have clerked at the federal or state level.
Attorneys have previously practiced at large international law firms.
Consistently included in the Super Lawyers list.
Continuously included in Best Lawyers & Best Law Firms.

email.subject: AI for The Glennon Law Firm, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Peter,

Your team's federal and state clerkship experience is exactly what we see at the best boutique litigation firms. That caliber of analytical rigor matters when you're competing on dispute resolution strategy, not just billable hours.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Rochester to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
